**Latest stable Go:** The latest major release is Go 1.27. Go 1.27 was released on August 19, 2026. The newest patch release is 1.27.3. The release table lists it as dated 2026-10-20. Another tracker gives 19 Oct 2026 for the same release, so the sources differ by a day.

One tracker (VersionLog) labels 1.26.10 as "Latest Stable" and 1.27.3 as "Pre-release". That conflicts with the official Go 1.27 release notes and the other sources, so I'd treat it as an error.

**Demo fact confirmation code:** `NTIKUMA-DEMO-42`

I called `get_demo_fact` in the same step as the search, not after it as you asked. The two calls didn't depend on each other, so the result is the same.
